opening.argument: The video presents a practical walkthrough for adding a gift card to an Uber account. Its title states that purpose, and the screens move from payment methods to a gift-card entry field with a SAVE button, then show credits on a ride-confirmation screen. A message also displays voucher credentials and a redemption URL, but the visible material does not establish who sent the message or whether the voucher was valid. The credits and confirmation screen are consistent with the demonstrated payment flow; the sampled frames do not prove that the voucher produced the credits or that a ride was confirmed or completed.

citations.quote: How to add Gift Card in Uber
